spec: OCP ACS Cold Plate, UQD/BMQC & Liquid-to-Liquid CDU

OCP-LC-THM-001.clause: OCP ACS §4.1 TCS Supply Coolant Temperature Envelope
OCP-LC-THM-001.title: TCS 供液温度工作包络（25–45 °C）
OCP-LC-THM-001.quote: Direct-to-chip TCS supply coolant temperature shall remain within the calibrated 25 degC to 45 degC operating envelope.

OCP-LC-THM-002.clause: OCP ACS §4.3 Liquid/Air Heat Split & Coolant Delta-T
OCP-LC-THM-002.title: 机柜液冷/风冷热量闭合与供回液温差控制
OCP-LC-THM-002.quote: High-density liquid-cooled racks shall close liquid + residual air heat fractions to 1.0 and keep coolant temperature rise within 5–15 K.

OCP-LC-HYD-001.clause: OCP ACS §5.2 Rack & TCS Secondary Loop Pressure Drop Budget
OCP-LC-HYD-001.title: 机柜级与二次侧管网总压降上限
OCP-LC-HYD-001.quote: Total secondary TCS loop pressure drop (headers + rack manifold + couplers + cold plates) shall not exceed 240 kPa or CDU external head.

OCP-LC-HYD-002.clause: OCP UQD/BMQC §3.1 Coupler Dynamic Pressure Rating
OCP-LC-HYD-002.title: UQD / BMQC 盲插快接头动态工作压力上限
OCP-LC-HYD-002.quote: UQD04 and BMQC blind-mate couplers shall operate at or below 450 kPa(g) including hot-swap and valve-closure transients.

OCP-LC-CDU-001.clause: OCP ACS CDU §4.2 CDU N+1 Capacity & Heat Exchanger Approach
OCP-LC-CDU-001.title: CDU N+1 换热冗余容量与端温差（Approach）上限
OCP-LC-CDU-001.quote: Liquid-to-liquid CDU assemblies shall maintain plate heat exchanger approach <= 5.0 K and meet full liquid load with N+1 unit redundancy.

OCP-LC-CDU-002.clause: OCP ACS CDU §6.1 Coolant Chemistry & Leak Detection Interlock
OCP-LC-CDU-002.title: 液冷工质规范（PG25/处理水）与漏液检测联锁
OCP-LC-CDU-002.quote: Secondary TCS loop must declare qualified coolant chemistry (PG25 or treated water) and integrated rack/tray leak detection.
